generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  email     String   @unique
  password  String
  fullName  String
  role      UserRole @default(SALES)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // A user (sales rep) can own many deals
  deals Deal[]

  @@map("users")
}

model Product {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  name            String
  description     String?
  category        String?
  price           Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  specifications  Json?    @default("{}")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("products")
}

model Customer {
  id          String          @id @default(uuid())
  companyName String
  contactName String?
  email       String?
  phone       String?
  address     String?
  status      CustomerStatus  @default(NEW)
  createdAt   DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime        @updatedAt

  // A customer can have many deals
  deals Deal[]

  @@map("customers")
}

model Deal {
  id                String    @id @default(uuid())
  title             String
  customerId        String
  salesRepId        String
  stage             DealStage @default(LEAD)
  value             Decimal   @db.Decimal(14, 2)
  probability       Int       @default(0) // 0 - 100
  expectedCloseDate DateTime?
  createdAt         DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime  @updatedAt

  customer  Customer  @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  salesRep  User      @relation(fields: [salesRepId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  quotes    Quote[]
  activities Activity[]

  @@map("deals")
}

model Quote {
  id          String      @id @default(uuid())
  dealId      String
  items       Json        @default("[]")
  totalAmount Decimal     @db.Decimal(14, 2)
  status      QuoteStatus @default(DRAFT)
  validUntil  DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime    @default(now())

  deal Deal @relation(fields: [dealId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("quotes")
}

model Activity {
  id        String       @id @default(uuid())
  dealId    String
  type      ActivityType
  notes     String?
  createdAt DateTime     @default(now())

  deal Deal @relation(fields: [dealId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("activities")
}

enum UserRole {
  ADMIN
  SALES
  CUSTOMER
}

enum CustomerStatus {
  NEW
  CONTACTED
  QUALIFIED
  PROPOSAL
  CLOSED
}

enum DealStage {
  LEAD
  QUALIFICATION
  PROPOSAL
  NEGOTIATION
  CLOSED_WON
  CLOSED_LOST
}

enum QuoteStatus {
  DRAFT
  SENT
  ACCEPTED
  REJECTED
  EXPIRED
}

enum ActivityType {
  CALL
  EMAIL
  MEETING
}

1: const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');
2: const { prisma } = require('../config/database');
3: const logger = require('../utils/logger');
4: 
5: /**
6:  * Middleware to protect routes with JWT authentication.
7:  * Expects Authorization: Bearer <token> header.
8:  */
9: async function authenticate(req, res, next) {
10:   try {
11:     const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
12: 
13:     if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
14:       return res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized: missing token' });
15:     }
16: 
17:     const token = authHeader.split(' ')[1];
18:     const decoded = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET);
19: 
20:     // Verify the user still exists in the database
21:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: decoded.userId } });
22:     if (!user) {
23:       return res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized: user not found' });
24:     }
25: 
26:     req.user = { userId: user.id, email: user.email, role: user.role };
27:     next();
28:   } catch (error) {
29:     logger.error(`Authentication error: ${error.message}`);
30:     return res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized: invalid token' });
31:   }
32: }
33: 
34: /**
35:  * Middleware factory to restrict routes to specific roles.
36:  * @param  {...string} allowedRoles
37:  */
38: function authorize(...allowedRoles) {
39:   return (req, res, next) => {
40:     if (!req.user) {
41:       return res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized' });
42:     }
43: 
44:     if (!allowedRoles.includes(req.user.role)) {
45:       return res.status(403).json({ success: false, message: 'Forbidden: insufficient permissions' });
46:     }
47: 
48:     next();
49:   };
50: }
51: 
52: module.exports = {
53:   authenticate,
54:   authorize,
55: };

(End of file - total 55 lines)

  }

  }

  // Don't leak internals in production

## 2. `src/controllers/userController.js` (cß║¡p nhß║¡t)

```javascript
const { prisma } = require('../config/database');
const { apiResponse, hashPassword } = require('../utils/helpers');
const logger = require('../utils/logger');

const userSelect = {
  id: true,
  email: true,
  fullName: true,
  role: true,
  isActive: true,
  createdAt: true,
  updatedAt: true,
};

async function createUser(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const { fullName, email, password, role = 'SALES' } = req.body;

    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
    if (existingUser) {
      const error = new Error('Email already exists');
      error.statusCode = 409;
      return next(error);
    }

    const hashedPassword = await hashPassword(password);
    const user = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        fullName,
        email,
        password: hashedPassword,
        role,
      },
      select: userSelect,
    });

    logger.info(`User created: ${user.email} (${user.role}) by ${req.user.email}`);
    res.status(201).json(
      apiResponse({
        success: true,
        message: 'User created successfully',
        data: user,
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
}

async function getAllUsers(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(req.query.page, 10) || 1);
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(1, parseInt(req.query.limit, 10) || 10), 100);
    const where = {};

    if (req.query.isActive !== undefined) {
      where.isActive = req.query.isActive === 'true';
    } else {
      where.isActive = true;
    }

    if (req.query.role && ['ADMIN', 'SALES', 'CUSTOMER'].includes(req.query.role)) {
      where.role = req.query.role;
    }

    if (req.query.search) {
      const search = req.query.search.trim();
      where.OR = [
        { fullName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { email: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ];
    }

    const [users, total] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.user.findMany({
        where,
        skip: (page - 1) * limit,
        take: limit,
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
        select: userSelect,
      }),
      prisma.user.count({ where }),
    ]);

    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);
    res.status(200).json(
      apiResponse({
        success: true,
        message: 'Users retrieved',
        data: users,
        meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages },
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
}

async function getUserById(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: req.params.id },
      select: userSelect,
    });

    if (!user) {
      const error = new Error('User not found');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      return next(error);
    }

    res.status(200).json(
      apiResponse({
        success: true,
        message: 'User retrieved',
        data: user,
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
}

async function updateUser(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const { fullName, email, role } = req.body;

    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!existingUser) {
      const error = new Error('User not found');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      return next(error);
    }

    if (email && email !== existingUser.email) {
      const duplicate = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
      if (duplicate) {
        const error = new Error('Email already in use');
        error.statusCode = 409;
        return next(error);
      }
    }

    const data = {};
    if (fullName !== undefined) data.fullName = fullName;
    if (email !== undefined) data.email = email;
    if (role !== undefined) data.role = role;

    const user = await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id },
      data,
      select: userSelect,
    });

    logger.info(`User updated: ${user.email} by ${req.user.email}`);
    res.status(200).json(
      apiResponse({
        success: true,
        message: 'User updated',
        data: user,
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
}

async function deleteUser(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;

    if (id === req.user.userId) {
      const error = new Error('Cannot delete your own account');
      error.statusCode = 403;
      return next(error);
    }

    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: userSelect,
    });

    if (!existingUser) {
      const error = new Error('User not found');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      return next(error);
    }

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { isActive: false },
    });

    logger.info(`User deleted: ${existingUser.email} by ${req.user.email}`);
    res.status(200).json(
      apiResponse({
        success: true,
        message: 'User deleted successfully',
        data: existingUser,
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
}

async function toggleUserActive(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;

    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: userSelect,
    });

    if (!existingUser) {
      const error = new Error('User not found');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      return next(error);
    }

    const user = await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { isActive: !existingUser.isActive },
      select: userSelect,
    });

    const statusText = user.isActive ? 'activated' : 'deactivated';
    logger.info(`User ${statusText}: ${user.email} by ${req.user.email}`);
    res.status(200).json(
      apiResponse({
        success: true,
        message: `User ${statusText}`,
        data: user,
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
}

async function resetUserPassword(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const { newPassword } = req.body;

    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!existingUser) {
      const error = new Error('User not found');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      return next(error);
    }

    const hashedPassword = await hashPassword(newPassword);
    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { password: hashedPassword },
    });

    logger.info(`Password reset for user: ${existingUser.email} by ${req.user.email}`);
    res.status(200).json(
      apiResponse({
        success: true,
        message: 'Password reset successfully',
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
}

module.exports = {
  createUser,
  getAllUsers,
  getUserById,
  updateUser,
  deleteUser,
  toggleUserActive,
  resetUserPassword,
};
```

  resetPasswordValidator,

 * tags:

 *   description: User management (admin only)
 */
router.use(authenticate, authorize('ADMIN'));

/**
 * @swagger
 * /api/users:

 *     summary: List all users
 *     tags: [Users]
 *     security:

 *       - in: query

 *       - in: query
 *         name: isActive
 *         schema: { type: boolean, default: true }
 *       - in: query
 *         name: search
 *         schema: { type: string }
 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: Users retrieved
 *       403:
 *         description: Forbidden
 */
router.get('/', getAllUsers);

/**
 * @swagger
 * /api/users:
 *   post:
 *     summary: Create a new user
 *     tags: [Users]
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     requestBody:
 *       content:
 *         application/json:
 *           schema:
 *             type: object
 *             required: [fullName, email, password]
 *             properties:

 *               password: { type: string, minLength: 6 }
 *               role: { type: string, enum: [ADMIN, SALES, CUSTOMER] }
 *     responses:
 *       201:
 *         description: User created
 *       409:
 *         description: Email already exists
 */
router.post('/', validate(createUserValidator), createUser);

/**
 * @swagger
 * /api/users/{id}:
 *   get:
 *     summary: Get a user by ID
 *     tags: [Users]
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     parameters:
 *       - in: path
 *         name: id
 *         required: true
 *         schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: User retrieved
 *       404:
 *         description: User not found
 */
router.get('/:id', validate(userIdParam), getUserById);

/**
 * @swagger
 * /api/users/{id}:
 *   put:
 *     summary: Update a user
 *     tags: [Users]
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     parameters:
 *       - in: path

 *         required: true
 *         schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
 *     requestBody:

 *         application/json:
 *           schema:
 *             type: object
 *             properties:
 *               fullName: { type: string, minLength: 2 }
 *               email: { type: string, format: email }
 *               role: { type: string, enum: [ADMIN, SALES, CUSTOMER] }
 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: User updated
 *       404:
 *         description: User not found
 *       409:
 *         description: Email already in use
 */
router.put('/:id', validate(userIdParam), validate(updateUserValidator), updateUser);

/**
 * @swagger
 * /api/users/{id}:
 *   delete:
 *     summary: Soft delete a user
 *     tags: [Users]

 *         description: User active status toggled

/**
